name: Queen Wezna
description: Monarch of Zhalfir at the time of the Phyrexian Invasion and now.

description_citations.text: "Zhalfir (plane)". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Queen Wezna confronts Teferi and demands why she should not carry out his sentence; he answers that if she kills him, they will win.

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Alone
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Alone" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Queen Wezna orders Jabari to lead the army while General Mageta recovers.
timeline.quote: You will lead the army until he recovers.

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Alone
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Alone" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Queen Wezna tosses Teferi an amber prison holding the frozen Wanderer.
timeline.quote: Small, frozen in time, likely moments after planeswalking, a warrior mid-strike.

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Alone
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Alone" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: A creed leader breaks the amber prison and the Wanderer is freed.
timeline.quote: the prison snapped, bursting open with a sharp report

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Alone
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Alone" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer learns she has been in Zhalfir a month, and Teferi reasons the anchor failed.

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Alone
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Alone" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer tells them New Phyrexia's invasion is upon them before she flickers away.
timeline.quote: New Phyrexia's invasion is upon us,

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Alone
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Alone" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Teferi phases Zhalfir out of Dominaria to spare it from the Phyrexian assault.
timeline.quote: He phased out Zhalfir alongside parts of northwestern Jamuraa because he wanted to spare it from the horrors of the Phyrexian assault.

citation.text: "Zhalfir (plane)", section "Phased out". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Disconnected from the Temporal Anchor, Teferi ends up in Zhalfir, finds only a decade had passed and reconnects with Sidar Jabari and Queen Wezna.
timeline.quote: He reconnected with Sidar Jabari and Queen Wezna and found that Kaervek had escaped his Amber Prison .

citation.text: "Zhalfir (plane)", section "Found and returned". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
